newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soybeans sharply lower on technical sales.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soybeans sharply lower on technical sales.

text.p: CBOT old-crop soybeans fell sharply in fast trade near the open on technical weakness and local sales, traders said.
"Everybody is watching $8.02 (per bushel) as a key level," said a floor trader. "If we go through that, watch out."
Commission houses were also heavy sellers on the open, but volume was said to be light, traders said.
Weather in the U.S. Midwest was also viewed as a bearish factor. Most forecasters see warmer temperatures and drier weather for much of this week, traders said.
At 0926 CDT, Soybeans were down nine to 22 cents, with July down 19-1/4 at $8.16 a bushel.
